title: Random Giggles
desc: Around the 5th of April, you started laughing for absolutely no reason at all, and it was the most contagious, joyful thing to witness. No prompt, no silly faces, just pure, spontaneous happiness bubbling out of you.
story: It would happen out of nowhere, you would be lying quietly, staring at nothing in particular, and then a giggle would just escape you, round and bright and completely unprovoked. We would look at each other, then back at you, completely baffled and utterly delighted. Sometimes it happened in the middle of the night during a feed, just a sudden little laugh in the dark that made the tiredness feel worth it. Whatever you were thinking about in that little mind of yours, we hope it always makes you that happy.
